failure_summary.description: Search or refinement results were often left unassigned or not saved to cache.
Agents searched despite compatible cached results, omitted new filters, or reprocessed unaffected domains.
Agents used a state abbreviation as a city, substituted an attraction type, or supplied a singleton for a range argument.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already explicitly requires saving every result, refining compatible cached results with new constraints, avoiding unaffected domains, and matching arguments to their schema-supported meanings. Similar reinforcement edits were rejected in prior steps, so repeating them would not add a distinct skill gap.
